kilometers north of Sounion (PI. 7, a), has long been recognized as the site of the 
camp built by Patroklos, the commander of Ptolemy IPs naval expedition to relieve 
Athens during the Chremonidean War. Wheler, who saw it from Sounion in 1676. 
remarks that it was still called Patroklea by some; his researches were, however, 
hampered, he writes, because, " I could get no Barque to go over." 1 By chance E. D. 
Clarke found himself on the island in late October 1802, but though of the early 
travellers he seems to have spent the most time on the island, he confines his remarks 
to the flora and to the identification of the spot, giving no indication of antique 
remains. 1 Credit for the discovery of the fortification on Gaidouronisi apparently 
belongs to Leake, who notes " some remains of a Hellenic fortress on the island." 1 
The remains are indicated on the Karten von Attika* but have never been fully 
described.*

was a x^pot' an important question for the study of Attic camps since it is used by 
both Pausanias and Strabo of the camp of Patroklos on Patroklou Nesos. The word 
is generally taken to mean a palisade of wooden stakes, and that it often had this 
meaning can be seen from Polybios's description of Roman soldiers carrying stakes 
with them to form such a palisade (XVIII, 18) and from Aristophanes's joke at the 
expense of a soldier who fell on a stake while jumping a trench (Acharncis, 1178). 
But if this were the only sort of defense to which x°-P°t could apply, not only would 
there be slight literary evidence in the appropriate period for the sort of camp which 
Koroni is shown by excavation to have been, but the topographical problem of Patro- 
klos's xapaJ;, so neatly settled by the rubble fortification on Gaidouronisi, would again 
be unsolved.

Η διπλωματική βασίζεται και εμπνεύστηκε με μικρές παραλλαγές από υπάρχων σχέδιο που βρίσκετε στα πλαίσια εγκατάστασης και μελέτης στον θαλάσσιο χώρο, κοντά στο Γαϊδουρονήσι και στην Παναγία των Οινουσσών, πλωτής πλατφόρμας τύπου MUP που βασίζεται στο έργο χρηματοδότησης και έρευνας από την ΕΕ, MUSICA(Multiple-use-of Space for Island Clean Autonomy). Το σύστημα αυτό έχει την δυνατότητα να φιλοξενεί εγκαταστάσεις όπως φωτοβολταικών , ανεμογεννητριών , κυματικής ενέργεια
